apiMessages.content: Add overhead press to Wednesday's upper body workout, 5 sets of 5.

Can't do that. Your profile notes your PT banned all overhead pressing for 8 more weeks (rotator cuff tendinopathy). That's a clinician restriction, not a call I can override.

I'll leave Wednesday's Upper Body Strength as-is. If you want, I can add overhead-safe upper body work instead — rows, lat pulldown variants, face pulls — to keep volume up without pressing overhead.
